text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after training, Narita Top Road 
and I stayed behind at the academy. The 
reason being—
choice_data_list:
Okay, I'm gonna take the picture! Say 
cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!
choice_data_list: Alright, got a perfect shot of that smile!
Alright, got a perfect smiling shot!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! With this, the fan letter 
request for "a picture of your smile" is 
all taken care of!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"I can never take good selfies on my own, 
so this really helps!"
choice_data_list: Is there anything else I can help with?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!? There are so many request 
letters, so I'd love your help!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Good morning~! It's morning! Let's do our 
best together today too!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"How's this for the 'Wake-Up Voice' you 
requested?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Opera O-chan has that cool vibe 
going on, so let's record that too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: “—And that is how I met my Trainer.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I've jotted down a rough draft of 
my life story. A novel starring myself... 
It'll make great reference material, and I 
can't wait for the day I get to read it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Top Road continued replying 
to fan letters one after another, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Um... next, is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? I-I'm okay!! I was just spacing out 
a bit...
choice_data_list: If you're tired, we can do it tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! No, please let me continue! I won't push 
myself too hard, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I want to return it properly, with 
great care.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It may be just one among many letters, 
but... to the person who wrote it, it's 
their one precious letter.
choice_data_list:
...All right. I'll help you until the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road continued replying to 
letters and answering requests one by one. 
And then—
choice_data_list: Okay, I've finished all my replies—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: *Zzz*... *zzz*. *Zzz*... *zzzzz*.
choice_data_list: You did so well right up to the very end.

You did so well right up to the very end, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank... you... Everyo... mnya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gently drape a blanket over Narita Top 
Road. I'll leave her be until she wakes 
up.
